features.months_late_now: How many months behind on payments right now
features.worst_delay_6m: Worst payment delay in the last 6 months
features.num_late_months_6m: Number of late months in the last 6 months
features.utilization: Share of the credit limit currently used
features.payment_ratio_6m: Share of billed amounts actually paid (6 months)
features.bill_trend_6m: Balance growth over 6 months, relative to the limit

protected_attributes_excluded.reason: US fair-lending law (ECOA / Regulation B) restricts using these in a credit decision. They are exported only as audit columns, never as model inputs.

reason_codes.output: up to 3 risk-raising reasons in plain language
reason_codes.note: Borderline flags can have fewer than 3 risk-raising features.

dataset.name: UCI Default of Credit Card Clients
dataset.citation: Yeh, I-C. & Lien, C-H. (2009). The comparisons of data mining techniques for the predictive accuracy of probability of default of credit card clients. Expert Systems with Applications, 36(2), 2473-2480.
dataset.population: 30,000 existing credit-card customers of one Taiwanese issuer, observed April-September 2005

intended_use: Educational demonstration: rank existing packaged accounts for analyst review inside a monthly credit-risk workflow.

operating_policy.name: Expected-cost review policy
operating_policy.rule: flag for review when p(default) x exposure x LGD > review_cost

parameters.note: All dollar parameters are synthetic classroom assumptions, not measured bank costs.

operating_policy.selected_on: validation split only; the test split was scored once after freezing

routes.priority_review: A credit analyst reviews the account and chooses the intervention.
routes.standard_monitoring: No review this month; the account stays in ordinary monitoring.

operating_policy.fallback: An account with missing fields or codes outside the documented ranges is excluded from scoring and logged for manual data review. It is never silently scored.
operating_policy.boundary: A score is not a default determination; the analyst decides. The model never contacts a customer, never changes a limit, and never labels anyone a defaulter.

limitations: One Taiwanese issuer, 2005, existing cardholders only; nothing here generalizes to other populations or eras.
All accounts share one observation window, so out-of-time validation is impossible in this dataset. A real bank validates behavioral models out-of-time.
All cost parameters (review cost, loss given default) are synthetic classroom assumptions.
Excluding SEX, MARRIAGE, and AGE from the inputs does not guarantee fairness: behavior features can act as proxies. The exported slice audit is the check, not the exclusion.
SHAP reason codes describe this model's arithmetic, not a customer's intent or circumstances.
excluded_uses: Real credit decisions of any kind (approval, limits, pricing, collection)
Scoring data from any other source or era
Automated adverse action without an analyst and a compliance-reviewed notice
